column1: # The response filter's known values as 38 encoders of seven runtimes
# wrote them, measured 2026-11-21 in each runtime's official image
# (PHP 8.4, Python 3.13, Node 22, Ruby 3.4, Go 1.27, Java 21 with
# Jackson 2.18 and Gson 2.11, .NET 8). Every value is made up. Each
# string is JSON-quoted here so that every byte is printable:
# a value line is `value<TAB>name<TAB>value`, an output line is
# `name<TAB>encoder<TAB>what the encoder wrote, without its quotes`.
